description: Draft Phase-1 prompt benchmark (v0) for Quake-MapGen: 17 game x mode targets the release candidate would claim, 8 prompts each (3 vague, 3 specific, 2 contradictory), plus 2 Quake 2 showcase probes. Prompts are run through the normal prompt-driven CLI only (no --game/--mode overrides). expected_requests list the explicit requests a correct brief must honour; they are not tuned to the current prompt parser.

cases.prompt: a quake 1 single player level
make me a Quake map I can play through on my own
cases.notes: No explicit mode keyword; 'on my own' implies single player.

cases.prompt: Quake episode-style level, something classic
cases.notes: Episode-style implies a campaign level; no explicit mode keyword.

cases.prompt: Quake 1 single-player level: gothic castle, 8 rooms, start in a quiet courtyard under an open sky, a lava moat around the keep, a gold key door guarding the exit, ogres and knights, ends at a slipgate exit.

Quake single player base level, 10 rooms, techbase theme, sewer section with slime, multi-level with a lift up to an upper catwalk, grunts and enforcers, a secret area hiding a quad damage, exit at the end.
Q1 SP map, 6 rooms, temple ruins, atmospheric and quiet exploration, a water pool landmark in the central hall, few monsters (zombies and fiends), a mega health secret, linear path to the exit.
a flat Quake 1 single-player map with extreme verticality
cases.notes: Contradiction: flat vs extreme verticality.

cases.prompt: a tiny Quake 1 single-player map with 32 rooms
cases.notes: Contradiction: tiny vs 32 rooms (the generator's maximum).

Q1 coop map for 2 players, techbase, 8 rooms, slime pits, separate coop start spots, plenty of ammo and health for both players, a grenade launcher early on, ends at an exit.
Quake co-op for 3 players, sewer theme, 7 rooms, multi-level with water channels, a shared nailgun room, enforcers and fiends, exit door at the end.
Quake 1 coop map for exactly 1 player
cases.notes: Contradiction: cooperative play with one player.

cases.notes: Contradiction: 16 cooperative players in a 2-room campaign map.
